Biography

Born in Brussels, and of Belgian and Haitian descent, Jasper grew up immersed in music—deeply influenced by his godfather, Lenny Kravitz, his cousin, Lost Frequencies, and a family legacy steeped in sound and creativity.

His sets are finely curated, blending Tech House and modern House with Hip-Hop and R&B into genre-crossing soundscapes that shift effortlessly between mood and energy. Rooted in the Brussels club scene and shaped by his time in New York and the American midwest, Jasper has developed a signature style that sits at the intersection of European sensibility and contemporary American culture.

A student at Indiana University's Kelley School of Business and VP of Europeans In Business, Jasper approaches DJing with the same instinct he brings to everything: a restless creative drive, a sharp ear for what moves a room, and an eye for where music and culture meet. Available for club nights, private events, and brand activations.
